text:
You're losing matches before she reads a word.

She opens your profile. One second. Gone.

Show your face. Eyes open. No sunglasses. No hiding.

Earned your body? Go shirtless. If not, dress sharp. Show a hobby. A trip. Something that proves your life is worth joining.

The submission smile kills you. Wide open mouth, desperate energy. Close it. Look calm. Look like you already won.

Fix the photo, fix the odds. Skip the photo, skip the game.
caption:
Men with real discipline and self improvement build a mindset that wins at dating psychology before they type one word.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
